title: Credit Department Ruling on Additional Security Deposits for Usage Growth
content:
## Ruling

1. On a tier whose terms allow reassessment, an additional Security Deposits deposit on the usage reassessment basis is assessed when the current basis bill exceeds the basis bill the existing deposit was computed from by more than the tier's usage-increase percent.
2. The additional deposit is the amount by which the account's deposits fall short of a fresh computation under the assessment rules, limited by the combined ceiling on the service account, and it is assessed only when that shortfall is at least the tier's smallest additional deposit.
3. *Retired clause.* The clause providing that a falling bill basis never reduces or partly refunds a deposit, and that only the refund review releases it, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## The two tests in sequence of reckoning

| Growth test (rule 1) | Shortfall against the smallest additional deposit (rule 2) | Additional deposit |
|---|---|---|
| exceeded by more than the percent | at least the minimum | assessed for the shortfall, within the ceiling |
| exceeded by more than the percent | below the minimum | not assessed |
| not exceeded by more than the percent | any | not assessed under this ruling |

## Hypothetical illustration (General Service Deposit: 25 percent, smallest additional deposit $100.00)

An existing deposit was computed from a basis bill of $400.00 and the account's deposits total $800.00. The current basis bill is $520.00, which exceeds $400.00 by 30 percent, more than 25 percent. A fresh computation comes to a hypothetical $1050.00; the shortfall is $250.00, at least $100.00, so an additional deposit of $250.00 is assessed, provided the account's deposits together stay within the ceiling. Had the fresh computation come to $870.00, the $70.00 shortfall would be below $100.00 and nothing would be assessed. Had the current basis bill been $500.00, it would exceed $400.00 by exactly 25 percent, not more, and rule 1 would not be met.

superseded_clauses: A falling bill basis never reduces or partly refunds a deposit; only the refund review releases it.
